title: Persistent NPC AI with LLM behavior
description: NPCs that have their own goals, personalities, and can take actions driven by LLM reasoning. NPCs can navigate the world, interact with characters, and pursue objectives autonomously.

title: Phase 5: Spween Integration
description: Scenes work and integrate with world. Deliverable: Characters can enter scenes, effects persist. Tasks: Add spween dependency, Implement EffectHandler, Create enter_scene and choose tools, Create 2-3 example scenes, Test scene flow

title: persistent 'game world' (IF/MUD style) data model integrated with zulip channels and roleplaying
Phase 2: Tool System
description: Define tools and execute them programmatically. Deliverable: Can execute tools via Rust API. Tasks: Create tool definitions and types, Implement navigation tools (go, look, examine), Implement inventory tools (take, drop, inventory), Create executor and validator, Write tests

title: Quest tracking system
description: Track character objectives, quest progress, rewards, and completion. Includes quest journal, branching quest paths, prerequisites, and integration with spween scenes for quest progression.

title: Phase 3: LLM Integration
description: LLM can call tools. Deliverable: Single character can navigate via LLM. Tasks: Create tool parser (regex-based), Create prompt builder with world state, Modify handle_message to use new system, Test with simple world (1 character, 3 rooms), Iterate on prompt format

title: Async time-based events
description: Events that trigger based on game time passing rather than player actions. Examples: day/night cycles, seasonal changes, scheduled NPC activities, random encounters based on time spent in locations.

title: Phase 1: Core World State
description: Create world state data structures and persistence. Deliverable: Can load world state, navigate rooms in code. Tasks: Create src/world/state.rs with all data structures, Create src/world/persistence.rs with RON serialization, Build initial world (5-10 rooms, 10-15 objects, 2-3 NPCs), Add unit tests

title: Procedural generation
description: Dynamically generate rooms, items, NPCs, and encounters. Includes generation algorithms for coherent worlds, loot tables, encounter balancing, and seeded generation for reproducibility.

title: Dynamic economy
description: Economy with shops, trading, dynamic prices based on supply/demand, merchant NPCs, bartering system, and currency management. Prices fluctuate based on world events and player actions.

title: Multiplayer (human + AI)
description: Allow human players to participate alongside AI characters. Includes player authentication, command parsing for human input, turn management with mixed human/AI players, and fair gameplay mechanics.

title: bot commands for editing the configs and saving back to file
Multiple save states
description: Support for multiple parallel worlds or save files. Includes save/load UI via Zulip commands, branching timelines, save state metadata, and world forking for experimentation.

title: Crafting system
description: System for combining items to create new items. Includes recipes, skill requirements, success/failure mechanics, and discovery of new recipes through experimentation.

title: Phase 6: Polish - Combat, Items, Advanced Features
description: Full-featured game world. Deliverable: Combat, equipment, NPCs, events all working. Tasks: Add combat mechanics, Add equipment system with stat mods, Add NPCs with dialogue, Add automatic events, Create richer world (10+ rooms, 20+ objects), Tune prompts

title: Tactical combat system
description: Turn-based tactical combat with positioning, abilities, status effects, and environmental factors. Includes combat grid/zones, action points, skill trees, and damage calculation with armor/resistances.

title: Phase 4: Turn System
description: Multiple characters take sequential turns. Deliverable: Multi-character sequential gameplay. Tasks: Create TurnCoordinator, Modify handle_message for sequential characters, Add action history to prompts, Test multi-character
